declarations.description:
Displays a timeline with events and a quiz based on those events.

As children, it should only contain `<webwriter-timeline-event>` elements in order
to function properly. Any other children may lead to unexpected behavior.
declarations.name: WebwriterTimeline

cssParts.description: The vertical line of the timeline (also in the quiz panel).
cssParts.name: line

cssParts.description: The dot of an event in the quiz panel. The dots in the timeline panel belong to `webwriter-timeline-event`.
cssParts.name: marker

cssParts.description: A draggable event card in the quiz panel. Media rules for authored images and videos in the details are adopted as one page-level stylesheet into the root that holds the element (counted per root, removed on disconnect); roots without `adoptedStyleSheets` skip it. Conversions: an `ol`, `ul`, `dl` or a series of `details` elements becomes a timeline, and the timeline can become `details` elements. A list item, a `dt` or a `summary` starts with the date or date range (ISO 8601 such as `1815-12-10`, or `10.12.1815`; a `time` element with `datetime` also works), then the title; what follows the title is the detail text. Dates with a year below 1000 need the ISO form with four digits, such as `0476`. The timeline reads and writes CSV (`.csv`, `text/csv`) with the columns `date`, `end_date`, `title` and `details` (UTF-8, comma or semicolon separated on import). A file import replaces all events. CSV keeps plain text only: the formatting, links and images in the details are dropped, and each paragraph of the details becomes one line. Signals: `score` is the share of events the reader placed correctly in the quiz after submitting (a number from 0 to 1, 0 until then), and `complete` is `true` once the answers are submitted. A receiving widget connects with an effect attribute such as `value-from="#timeline-id[score]"`. The timeline has no effects of its own. Theme: text uses `--ww-text-color` and `--ww-font-family`; the line, dots and highlights use `--ww-theme-accent-1` and `--ww-theme-accent-2`. Print: shows the active panel without tabs and controls. The quiz prints as a worksheet (event cards and empty date boxes).
cssParts.name: card
